about.title:
I'm Sadaf

This is where it started.
about.subtitle: I didn't start with code. I started with design — learning layout, hierarchy, and user experience through years of visual design and WordPress work. That instinct is still at the core of what I build, now powered by React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. The result: websites that don't just work, they feel right.
